ShortDescription.Value: Network editing tools: connections, curves, loops, parallels, slopes and node editing

Publish.LongDescription:
Port of the Network Multitool by MacSergey for Cities: Skylines, published with his permission. Eight modes to edit roads and rails:
* Add node: split a segment with a new node * Remove node: remove a node and merge its segments * Slope: give a chain of nodes a constant slope * Arrange: spread a chain of nodes evenly along one smooth curve * Loop: build a loop or arc between two segments * Connection: connect two segments with a chain of arcs * Curve: connect two segments with a smooth curve * Parallel: build a new road or track alongside a chain of segments
With a one-way road, the preview shows the traffic direction with arrows and Ctrl+Alt+I reverses it. Elevated roads get a pillar every 200 m at most instead of 80 m. Every key can be changed in the mod options. Translated into every language of the game.
